title: 非标定制方案沟通
titleEn: Custom Design: From Renderings to CAD Drawings

intro.background: 非标定制是教玩具外贸的核心竞争力。流程：客户发场地照片/CAD → 设计师出3D效果图（3D rendering）→ 客户改稿（通常2-3轮）→ 确认后出CAD施工图（working drawings）→ 报价。英语沟通要点：rendering、layout、elevation、dimension、material list、revision。
intro.desc: 掌握非标定制全流程的英语表达。

oneLiner.en: In custom design, the 3D rendering is not the product — it is the start of a conversation that ends with approved CAD drawings.
oneLiner.cn: 非标定制中，3D效果图不是产品——它是对话的开始，结束于确认的CAD施工图。

vocab.ex: We will send a 3D rendering in 5 days.
The CAD drawing shows exact dimensions.
The elevation shows the front view.
The material list includes wood type and finish.
vocab.exCn: 材料清单包括木材和表面处理。

vocab.ex: We can make revisions based on your feedback.
vocab.exCn: 我们可以根据您的反馈修改。

mistakes.wrong: I will send you a design.
mistakes.right: Our design team will produce a 3D rendering and layout drawing within 5 working days.
mistakes.cn: 错误：说发个设计。要具体说什么图、几天。

advanced.en: Our design process includes: initial 3D concept rendering within 5 days, up to two free revision rounds, and final CAD working drawings with material list upon approval.
advanced.cn: 我们的设计流程：5天内出3D概念图，最多2轮免费修改，确认后出CAD施工图和材料清单。

advanced.en: The approved CAD drawings will include floor plans, elevations, sections, and a detailed material list — all at 1:50 scale, ready for production.
advanced.cn: 确认后的CAD图包括平面、立面、剖面和详细材料清单——全部1:50比例，可直接生产。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: The 3D rendering looks good, but can we change the slide color from blue to green?
lines.cn: 3D效果图不错，但滑梯颜色能从蓝色改成绿色吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Sure, no problem. We will update the rendering with the green slide and send it back within 2 working days. Any other changes?
lines.cn: 当然没问题。我们会更新效果图，把滑梯改成绿色，2个工作日内发回。还有其他改动吗？

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Also, can we add a small sandbox near the reading corner?
lines.cn: 另外，能在阅读角旁边加个小沙池吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Yes, we can add the sandbox. We will send the revised rendering with both changes by Wednesday.
lines.cn: 可以加沙池。我们周三前把改好两处的效果图发给您。

fillBlank.q: We can make ____ based on feedback.

scenario.q: A client wants changes to the 3D rendering: change slide color and add a sandbox. How do you respond?
scenario.modelAnswer: Absolutely, we can make both changes — the slide color to green and add a small sandbox near the reading corner. We will send the revised 3D rendering within 2 working days. Once you approve, we will produce the final CAD working drawings with the material list.
scenario.cn: 当然，两处都改——滑梯改绿色，阅读角旁加小沙池。2个工作日内发改好的3D图。您确认后我们出最终CAD施工图和材料清单。

culture.title: 改稿的边界
culture.content: 客户改设计是常态，但要设边界：3轮以内免费，超过3轮收设计费（通常500-1000美金，签约后退）。这是行业惯例，提前说清楚避免扯皮。

rounds.ai: Can we change the slide color?
Can you add a sandbox to the layout?
rounds.hint: 可以加，周三前发修改版。

rounds.ai: How many revision rounds are included?
